description: A public SPW Zenodo deposit provides synthetic households, persons and activity destinations for Florida under CC BY 4.0. The University of Virginia team’s README describes CSVs inside the data ZIP for people, household links, residence sites, activity locations and person-to-activity assignments. A contact matrix and several validation plots are listed separately. The source table names IPUMS household distributions, GPW demographic counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places. Modellers could use the synthetic daily population as one demand layer when constructing Florida evacuation or service-restoration scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this state dataset. A limitation is that it contains no hurricane alert response, vehicle ownership, household risk perception or road capacity in the public description. It was made for population interactions, not validated evacuation routing. The archive was not downloaded; trip totals and location accuracy were not checked.
